 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.26 of 2024 registered at Police Station Dimani, District Morena (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366(ka), 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC & Sections 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent a n d h a s been falsely implicated.

It is further argued that allegedly, the prosecutrix got missting on 12.02.2024 and recovered on 17.02.2024 and immediate after her recovery, statement u/S.164 of Cr.P.C. has been recorded on 17.02.2024 wherein, she has not made allegation against the present applicant/accused.

As per her statements, she wanted to marry with applicant/accused, however, her parents were not ready and they tried to arrange marriage with another person, therefore, she left the house on her own volition, in these circumstances, question of abduction does not arise.

It is further argued that as per the statement of prosecutrix, she traveled with applicant/accused at Ahmedabad, Delhi,
however, there is no evidence that while travelling in public transport, prosecutrix ever tried to Anoop Mahore vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145633186/
1 resist or raise alarm to escape her.

sentences.text: Further submission is that prosecutrix solemnized the marriage with applicant/accused and was residing as his wife, in these circumstances, so also, in the light of the fact applicant is in custody since 19.02.2024 and after conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed, therefore, custodial interrogation of the applicant is no more required.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents and he is permanent resident of District Morena (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconding or tempering with prosecution case.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
